subject: Man Utd come from two goals down to beat Roma 3-2 at Old Trafford
title: Two down, Cunha up

lines.vo: Two-nil down after eighteen minutes. Man United still won three-two.
Roma came in unbeaten in Serie A. Their defence then took a day trip.
lines.footage: Roma first half goals Old Trafford

lines.vo: A poor Balerdi clearance led to the equaliser. Matheus Cunha scored in the eighty-third and eighty-sixth minutes. Three minutes, two goals, no mercy.
Bruno Fernandes had just accepted being benched. His penalty was saved, then retaken, then scored. Persistence. Or paperwork.
The win ended a nine-match winless run. Cunha then saw a second yellow in stoppage time. Hero and early bath, in one evening.
